_note: FL11 fragment. flags: one full record per owned index of $0100-$019D with a flag site or a death-action row (D3). proposals: spine indices (touched by more than one scene group). _block_only and _no_use are informational (keys starting with _ are ignored by the tool): indices whose block is reachable only through StageBgChange, and indices with no use.

D3.name: event triggers / death actions
D3.lifecycle: Bytes $0A20-$0A3F of the save block. ApplyAllEventBlocks (scene load, after InitCameraBounds and before SpawnSceneActors, and at inventory close) walks all 256 bits; a set flag $0100+n applies event block n when the block's scene byte equals sceneCurrent. Scene loads never clear these bits. The only clear sites are the sg52 blockers ($0125-$012A), the Ishtar room controller ($0149-$0150 at each room start), the Adrift script ($0120), the stone coffin retry ($013B), Kara's return ($0119) and the prologue ($017C-$017F). Blocks n >= 158 have no table entry (LookupEventBlock does not bound the index); no flag in $019E-$01FF has a setter.
D3.access: COP word forms ($CD/$CF/$D1/$D3 and the Branch/Wait variants), SetFlag_0100/TestFlag_0100 (death-action indices, pyCC Dark Space portal), ApplyAllEventBlocks (LDA $0A20,Y), enemy-spawn rows of tables/scene_actors.asm (last operand = event-block index, stored at $7F0024).
